name: 20115 · Marshall, VA
findings: ZIP 20115 (Marshall) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20115 (Marshall) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 20115 (Marshall) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
